overview.Name: Webull Corporation
overview.Description: Webull Corporation operates as a digital investment platform. The company offers various products and services, including trading, wealth management product distribution, market data and information, user community, and investor education. Its platform enables retail investors to trade securities through its licensed broker dealer in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Australia, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, Thailand, Japan, South Africa, the Netherlands, and internationally. Webull Corporation was founded in 2016 and is headquartered in Saint Petersburg, Florida.
